segments.ja257:1.1: Nāyaṃ gharānaṃ kusalo, lolo ayaṃ valīmukho;
segments.ja257:1.3: Kataṃ kataṃ kho dūseyya, evaṃdhammamidaṃ kulaṃ.
segments.ja257:2.1: Nayidaṃ cittavato lomaṃ, nāyaṃ assāsiko migo;
segments.ja257:2.3: Siṭṭhaṃ [satthaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] me janasandhena, nāyaṃ kiñci vijānati.
segments.ja257:3.1: Na mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā, bhātaraṃ bhaginiṃ sakaṃ;
segments.ja257:3.3: Bhareyya tādiso poso, siṭṭhaṃ dasarathena meti.
